stronger_left_out.name: Admiralty Islands
stronger_left_out.reason: Kept as review. For: the tourism board gives it a dedicated page (about 25 dive sites, 15 min by boat) and Wikivoyage shows it in a photo; Wikipedia has Admiralty Group. Against: only one real counted source, no landing, reached only by operator dive or boat trips (the group is a place, not a vehicle). Owner call; I lean keep because it is the island's headline dive area after Ball's Pyramid.

strongest_outsiders.note: Every other candidate lies on the island itself. Ball's Pyramid is the only kept place outside the proposed span, and the strongest place in the region by views.

benchmark.applicable: None of the named NZ benchmarks lie in this region. Negative-benchmark analogues behave correctly: a once-a-week or occasion venue (weather station balloon launch) rejected; a vehicle or operator is not a spot (Admiralty Islands is a place but held for review as operator-only); a gateway whose draw is beyond it was not relevant.

review_list_for_owner.name: Middle Beach
review_list_for_owner.case: Both counted sources only name it as the Clear Place walk start; neighbours Lagoon Beach 900 m away. Skeptic would drop it unless the owner wants township beaches. Pin if kept: -31.5247,159.07456 (OSM natural=beach way 157694803).

review_list_for_owner.name: Admiralty Islands
review_list_for_owner.case: Tourism board dedicated page (about 25 dive sites, 15 min by boat), Wikivoyage mentions; no landing, operator dive/boat trips only. Skeptic leans keep. Pin if kept: -31.50469,159.0681 (OSM Sugarloaf Island coastline midpoint). Would sit as a spot of the island if approved; photo candidate Admiralty Group off Ned's Beach (Commons).
